question: dame la comisión efectiva en porcentaje de cada nivel de riesgo de comercio, ordenada de mayor a menor
sql:
SELECT d.risk_tier, 100.0 * SUM(d.mdr_bps) / 100 AS commission_pct
FROM dim_merchant d
WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.is_active = true
GROUP BY d.risk_tier
ORDER BY commission_pct DESC
